provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Arkham Horror: The Card Game Learn to Play (Revised Core Set, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Each player chooses an investigator and takes their pack
Investigator card faceup in your play area; shuffle your deck
Choose a lead investigator: they take the lead investigator token and the Campaign Guide
Damage, horror, clue/doom and resource tokens in a pool within reach
Chaos bag: the tokens for your chosen difficulty (first game: the 16 shown)
Draw {n}; set aside weaknesses and redraw; one mulligan of up to 5 cards; shuffle set-aside cards back
Gather every card of each encounter set the Campaign Guide lists for the scenario
Agenda deck in order, 1a on top
Act deck in order, 1a on top
Scenario reference card next to the agenda deck
Put the starting locations into play unrevealed side up as the guide says; set aside the rest
Set aside the cards the scenario names; shuffle the rest into the encounter deck
Read the scenario introduction and the faceup agenda and act
Place investigators at the starting location and reveal it (clues = its clue value, often per investigator)
Round 1 skips the Mythos phase - start with the Investigation phase
